text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with Verxina,
we stopped by a jewelry shop—

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry.
We are currently out of stock...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I see... Thank you for your trouble.
I'll be sure to drop by again.
It seemed she couldn't find what she was looking for, as she left the store in a hurry.
choice_data_list: What are you looking for?
What are you looking for?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
It's a butterfly-themed brooch.
It seems only a few were in stock.
choice_data_list: They don't sell it online?
They don't sell it online?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...It seems they do.
I see, in stock at regional locations, huh.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"A little under two hours by limited express train...
There are plenty of open seats, too."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: I will head over now. My apologies, but let's dismiss for today here.
choice_data_list: What!? We're going all the way to the shop!?
What!? We're going all the way to the shop!?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Whether it is truly worthy of me or not.
I shall go see for myself with my own eyes.

Even though Verxina is very responsible,
it's far too long a journey to let her go all alone.
choice_data_list: I'll come with you, just in case something happens.
I'll come too, just in case something happens.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... That is very reassuring.
Well then, I look forward to working with you.

I quickly reserved a seat on the limited express
and headed to a jewelry shop out in the countryside.

And while the sun was still high, we managed
to reach our destination—the jewelry shop—

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Here is the item you were looking for.
Please feel free to pick it up and have a look.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes, I shall take a close look.

The brooch that emerged was visibly of the finest quality.
Perhaps the butterfly's eyes were emeralds.
Combined with the golden body, it was a truly gorgeous design.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Well-calculated facet cuts... Impressive.
The light reflects exactly as I imagined it would.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
The curvature of the wings is smooth and flawless.
Crafted so exquisitely, it looks ready to take flight at any second—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
You've shown me something wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Trainer-san.
Shall we head home?
choice_data_list: Ah... Yeah!? Wait, what!?
Yeah... wait, huh?!

text_block_list.text: In the end, Verxina left without buying that brooch...
choice_data_list: Was that brooch not what you expected?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I had hoped for a touch more elegance in the gold's texture.
As it stands, it is far too conspicuous.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: The actual article gave an arrogant impression. What I am looking for is something that displays the true "dignity" of a queen.
choice_data_list: I see. That's a shame.
I see. That's too bad.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
No. If anything, I should apologize.
Even though you went through the trouble of joining me.
And then, while walking toward the station, an antique shop caught my eye.

In the display window, dresses and brooches
were on display, and—
choice_data_list: (This... I think it would suit Verxina)

text_block_list.text:
Verxina might be looking for something with a bit more luxury.
Personally, though, I thought it suited her perfectly.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Is something the matter?
Did something catch your eye—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: That butterfly brooch...!
The moment Verxina entered the shop, she asked to see the brooch and inspected every single detail—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"A weighty, deep gold... not too flashy,
yet brimming with a quiet, powerful presence..."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
This is it, this is the one!
This is what I've been searching for...!
choice_data_list: Still, the design isn't quite what you were looking for—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes. But this one is just fine.
This is truly the ideal brooch of "dignity."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
We've finally crossed paths...!
Thank you so much for finding me.
choice_data_list: Actually, I was looking because I thought it might suit you.
Actually, I was looking because I thought it might suit you.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that so?
And that's why you got me something so wonderful—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Impressive as always.
You're watching me more closely than anyone else.
choice_data_list: Your strong feelings are what drew the brooch to you.
It was your feelings that drew the brooch to you.
I'm so glad I happened to find it!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Impressive as always.
You're watching me more closely than anyone else.
choice_data_list: Your strong feelings are what drew the brooch to you.
It was your feelings that drew the brooch to you.
I'm so glad I happened to find it!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that's a wonderful way of looking at it.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"However, it wasn't just my feelings alone.
Trainer, you searched right alongside me,
seeing things through the exact same eyes, didn't you?"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
This is something we drew together.
Fufufu.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
No, surely it was meant to be.
After all, it fits so perfectly.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "So... right after buying it, though it might seem childish—"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
May I walk around
wearing this brooch?
